tables.caption: Physiochemical Properties of 46 AMPs Derived from Sequences Identified in African Frog, Scorpion, Tick, and Primate Speciesa
footnotes: * – AMPs containing more than one cysteine residue were evaluated in their reduced forms throughout the study. N – Novel derivative. U – Unknown antimicrobial activity.
This is the retention time for the major fraction collected during semipreparative HPLC of each peptide supplied at c 80% purity.
The sum of the lipophilicity of the constituent amino acids of the peptides was determined from Frecer28 calculated using πFP = log Po/w(a.a.) – log Po/w(Gly) (Suppl. Table S1).
The sum of the side chain surface areas (SCSA) of the constituent amino acids of the peptides were determined from Frecer28 as calculated from the Connolly surfaces method46 (Suppl. Table S1).
